seoPage.metaDescription: EV Charging Types Explained — AC, DC & What You Actually Need — practical charging guidance for Indian buyers.
seoPage.intro: Confused by AC slow charging, DC fast charging, and connector names? This guide explains charging types in plain language for India buyers — focused on what fits your parking and commute.

editorialSections.title: Beginner introduction
paragraphs: Charging type is about speed and location: slow AC at home or work, faster DC at public stations. Your daily need is usually solved by AC if you can park long enough.

editorialSections.title: AC vs DC in practice
bullets: AC (often 3.3–7.4 kW home): overnight top-ups for city commutes.
DC fast (public): useful for trips and emergencies — not required every day for everyone.
Connector compatibility: confirm what your shortlisted model accepts before buying.

editorialSections.title: Charging convenience realism
paragraphs: If you cannot charge where you park, daily life depends on public infrastructure — that may be improving but is not uniform in every city.

misconceptions.myth: You must DC fast charge daily
misconceptions.reality: Most owners rely on AC for routine km.
Uncertified extension setups carry fire risk — use proper equipment.

faq.question: What is AC charging?
faq.answer: Alternating current charging — typical home/workplace wallboxes and many society points.

faq.question: What is DC fast charging?
faq.answer: Direct current at public stations for quicker sessions — useful on highways.

faq.question: Do I need a fast charger at home?
faq.answer: Usually no — many Indian commutes suit overnight AC.

faq.question: Will the wrong plug slow me down?
faq.answer: Yes — verify connector and on-board charger kW on your variant.

faq.question: Next step?
faq.answer: Read fast vs slow guide, then compare models with your parking situation.
